visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an outdoor market area with white parasols and historical white buildings with red wooden frames. A crowd of people is strolling through the cobblestone alley. (2) The scene cuts to a large outdoor sign for 'BUBU ART CAFE' featuring a picture of toast decorated as a famous painting with a fork and knife icon. (3) A close-up shows a menu board titled 'Artist Toasts DIY' as a man's hand points to the different creative options. (4) The main character, a man in a black Porter t-shirt, speaks directly to the camera while smiling and gesturing. (5) A white palette-shaped plate is shown, holding a slice of white bread and small dabs of colorful cream. (6) In a montage, hands are seen using palette knives to spread the colorful cream onto the bread, recreating classic art. (7) Three finished toasts representing Van Gogh paintings are displayed on white plates. (8) Transition to 'La JIA BONG,' an outdoor food stall with a vintage refrigerator serving as a service window. (9) Interior of the shop reveals a retro-chic aesthetic with tiled tables and warm lighting. (10) A hand opens the vintage light green refrigerator, revealing a small green bowl of food tucked inside. (11) Close-up of the dish: rice topped with dark sausages, liver sausage, and a bright yellow egg yolk. (12) At a new location, a pink sign for 'REPIE' is shown outdoors. (13) A pink shopping bag with the brand logo is picked up from a pink wooden counter. (14) Inside an office, a long cardboard box is opened to reveal a massive, sugar-dusted apple strudel. (15) A woman in black tastes the strudel and covers her mouth in delight, followed by another woman in glasses laughing and clapping while the man continues the conversation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy travel and food guide to the Shenji New Village area in Taichung. By showcasing three distinct and trendy shops—an art-themed cafe, a retro-styled rice bowl stall, and a specialized apple strudel bakery—the creator encourages viewers to visit these locations through positive reviews and highlighting unique 'Instagrammable' features.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The vlogger directly visits three shops, mentions their names in speech and text, and provides enthusiastic endorsements of their food products.
